overview_description.description:
All teams develop specific ways of doing things - how they handle pull requests, respond to incidents, handle bugs, hire new employees etc. These processes are important, but they often don't get documented, rely on lots of manual handling, and jump between multiple SaaS tools.

Workflow86 is an all-in-one platform for building, automating, and managing your team’s operations playbooks and business processes. It comes with lots of built-in functionality so you can do more with just Workflow86, while still making it super easy to integrate with other tools when needed.

You use drag and drop components to build out your process step by step with forms, business logic, document templates and more. It's no-code, so non-technical team members (bizops, HR, admin, legal, risk and compliance) can set up playbooks and processes on their own.

Once a playbook/process has been built, you can run them automatically and at scale. Trigger playbooks automatically on a specific event, time, submission.

product.name: AI Copilot
product.description: An AI-driven tool that creates, edits, and redesigns business process automations based on user descriptions or uploaded diagrams.

product.name: Workflow Automation Platform
product.description: A platform to design, execute, and manage complex business workflows combining AI, human tasks, and custom code.

product.name: Form Builder
product.description: A tool to create customizable forms for data collection and user input within workflows.

product.name: Task Manager with Human-in-the-Loop
product.description: A system to assign, track, and manage manual tasks within automated workflows, pausing automation until task completion.

product.name: Custom Code Execution
product.description: Capability to run custom JavaScript or Python code within workflows for handling complex or edge-case scenarios.

product.name: Integration Framework (APIs, Webhooks, Zapier)
product.description: Tools to connect workflows with external applications via APIs, webhooks, and Zapier for data exchange and event triggering.
